svg.font-family: Inter, 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Evolution — concept sheet 02: the dish
svg.desc: Play-scale scene of the petri dish at camera zoom 1.0 (1 px = 1 world unit): dark-field background, dish wall, three ecology zones, three nutrient mote types, DNA fragments, depth particles, vignette, four cells (the player, a rival mid-engulf, its prey and a grazer resting in the shallows) and a zoomed-out inset at high mass. Code-drawn SVG, no raster content. See docs/concept-art/README.md for the palette constants.
